subject: Provisioning SOC 2 Type II (gated by NDA) — AtlasPayments
messages:
From: Sara Thomas <sara.thomas@atlaspayments.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@atlaspayments.com
Date: Tue, 18 Apr 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for SOC 2 Type II (audit period & NDA)

Hi Kimberly,

We are about to kick off procurement for an expanded payments integration and need to collect your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or a bridge letter if applicable). A couple quick asks so we can track internally:

- Can you confirm the audit period covered by your latest Type II?
- Our security team requires the report to be shared under an executed NDA — can you send your standard NDA or confirm next steps for gating the document?
- If the Type II does not cover our target window (we're aiming to go live in June), would you be able to provide a bridge letter or interim statement?

We can countersign your NDA electronically; attaching our procurement contact for logistics.

Thanks,
Sara Thomas
Senior Security Program Manager
AtlasPayments
[Attachment: procurement_contact_v1.vcf]
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Sara Thomas <sara.thomas@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: procurement@atlaspayments.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for SOC 2 Type II (audit period & NDA)

Hi Sara — thanks for reaching out and for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below: 

- Audit period: our most recent SOC 2 Type II covers Nov 1, 2026 — Oct 31, 2027.
- NDA gating: we require a mutually executed NDA before sharing the full report. I've attached our standard Mutual NDA (Redwood Mutual NDA v3). If you prefer to countersign AtlasPayments' NDA, please send it and loop in marissa_cole (legal).
- Bridge letter: we can provide a bridge letter covering changes since Oct 31, 2027 where appropriate; Rishi (security) can scope what we can include.

Requested next steps:
1) Please sign and return the attached Redwood NDA or send your NDA for countersignature.
2) Once NDA is countersigned, we will provide the gated SOC 2 Type II PDF (and a short cover note and scope summary).
3) If you need an explicit bridge letter, indicate whether it should address control changes or infrastructure changes; Rishi will follow up.

Attaching: Redwood_Mutual_NDA_v3.pdf (for faster turnaround)

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Accounts — Redwood Inference
[kimberly_park@redwood.com]
[Attachment: Redwood_Mutual_NDA_v3.pdf (PDF, 23 KB)]
From: Sara Thomas <sara.thomas@atlaspayments.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@atlaspayments.com
Date: Tue, 18 Apr 2028 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for SOC 2 Type II (audit period & NDA)

Thanks, Kimberly.

I attached AtlasPayments' standard confidentiality addendum and a signed cover page for your NDA (we can do DocuSign if easier). Please countersign the AtlasPayments NDA if that is your preference — procurement would like to keep our contract paperwork consistent.

We're mainly concerned with the audit window (June go-live) so the Nov 2026 — Oct 2027 window sounds fine. Could you also confirm expected delivery SLA after countersign (we typically expect gated reports within 48 hours of a fully executed NDA)?

Attached: AtlasPayments_NDA_Addendum_signed.pdf

Appreciate the help — cc'ing procurement.

— Sara
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Thomas <sara.thomas@atlaspayments.com>, procurement@atlaspayments.com
Date: Tue, 18 Apr 2028 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for SOC 2 Type II (audit period & NDA) — audit period and bridge letter scope

Kimberly / Marissa — short security note to confirm optics for the external ask and what we can release under NDA.

- Audit period confirmation: Nov 1, 2026 — Oct 31, 2027 (Type II).
- Delivery SLA: once we have a fully executed NDA (both parties signed), Security will release the gated PDF within 2 business days. If procurement needs faster turnaround we can prioritize but would still want the executed NDA first.
- Bridge letter: we can provide a bridge letter that summarizes material control changes since the report period (e.g., new key management provider, changes to VPC egress logging configuration, rollout of quantized inference nodes). For external consumption we avoid operational specifics; a high-level statement will be used.

Marissa — can Legal countersign AtlasPayments' addendum or advise if we should insist on our standard? Also, please attach the final redline (if any) to the record (HubSpot HS-45219).

Sara / Procurement — once NDA is countersigned please let us know preferred delivery channel. We typically provide:
- SOC2_TypeII_Report_2027_gated.pdf [watermarked "For Recipient: AtlasPayments"]
- SOC2_Summary_CoverNote.txt
- Optional: Bridge_Letter_AtlasPayments.pdf (if requested and scoped)

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: internal_security_checklist_v2.docx]
